messages:
anya (PM): Heads-up — NovaBank legal pushed a signed LOI but they want Private deployment + KMS + audit logs live by 2024-05-15. They called it a blocker for the enterprise rollout. Can we confirm feasibility and firm dates?

matt (AE): They said $1.2M ARR if we hit that date. Contract goes to procurement next week. They listed three must-haves: private control plane in VPC, customer-managed KMS + key-rotation support, and immutable audit trail exports.

sara (CS): Escalation from their CISO: SOC2 evidence + endpoint allowlist are non-negotiable. They've already run preliminary security scans. They're willing to accept a limited-alpha installer for prod infra if we provide compliance attestations.

julio (Eng): Rough take: VPC control plane + installer + audit logging are doable in an MVP by 5/15 if we scope HSM/KMS to cloud-KMS integration (AWS KMS/GCP KMS) — full HSM/HSM-backed HSM-to-HSM key import is heavier. Need a 6-sprint focused effort (2 engs + 1 infra). Can we drop SAML/SCIM in scope? That adds a couple weeks.

anya (PM): Proposal: split into 2 deliverables so we can sign:
- Must for go-live (by 2024-05-15): private control plane deployment in customer's VPC, AWS/GCP KMS integration with documented KMS rotation process, basic immutable audit logs export (S3 export + retention policy), and SOC2 checklist items we can provide.
- Stretch (after go-live): on-prem HSM integration, full SCIM provisioning, advanced key-import flows.

Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Private control plane deployed into customer VPC using our installer (versioned).
- Key encryption via customer KMS (AWS/GCP) with documented rotation and proof-of-access tests.
- Audit logs exported to customer S3 with SHA256 checksums and 90-day retention.
- SOC2 artifacts: ingestion of evidence into their auditor portal + contact for attestation.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency increase <= 15% vs hosted baseline for usual routes.
```

matt (AE): NovaBank will accept cloud-KMS for initial contract if we provide a roadmap appendix that shows HSM timeline within 90 days post-launch. They'll sign with a phased acceptance clause.

julio (Eng): OK on cloud-KMS. Two notes: 1) installer will need bootstrap credentials flow — recommend we ship with a one-time bootstrap token + docs for customer ops to rotate. 2) Audit export parity requires small schema change in the runtime to attach request-id + user-id to logs. Estimate +1 week.

sara (CS): I'll capture the acceptance criteria in the SOW and confirm SOC2 artifact handoff process with their auditor. Also requesting a dedicated onboarding week from our SREs.

ops-bot: Created JIRA INFR-4827 "NovaBank private deploy MVP" and linked to product epic PROD-3391. Assignee: julio. Sprint target: sprint-12 -> sprint-14.

anya (PM): Next steps: julio to confirm resource commit and exact ETA by EOD; matt to update legal with phased acceptance language; sara to lock in SRE onboarding week. If everyone aligns, I'll push for a verbal commitment with their procurement today. :eyes:

julio (Eng): Confirming resource commit: I can allocate 2 engineers + 0.5 infra support. ETA for MVP (cloud-KMS + audit export + installer) = 2024-05-13. Will open PRs for schema change by tomorrow.

matt (AE): I'll send the phased acceptance wording to procurement and copy @anya and @sara.

sara (CS): Booked SRE onboarding week 2024-05-06 to 2024-05-10. Added NovaBank to our onboarding calendar.

anya (PM): Great — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for commitment notes. If anything slips we call a quick triage with Julio + SRE. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from matt, :rocket: from sara)
